title: 通信工学
subtitle: Communication Engineering
educationalGoal: This course introduced the basic topology of communication systems, properties of basic information like voices and videos, imperfection of transmission systems that makes data errors, basis of digital modulation/demodulation and multiplexing scheme. For each topic, basis and principle are explained with basic formulas.
advice: This course is constructed following chapters: i) Basic topology of telecommunication systems, ii) Basic properties of information (voice, video, data) on telecommunication systems, iii) Entropy of information, iv) Communication disturbance due to imperfections of transmission (noise, linear/non-linear distortion), v) Digital modulation/demodulation and its filtering techniques, vi) Multiplexing techniques (Frequency division multiplex, Time division multiplex, Code division multiplex,)
requiredKnowledge: Acquisition of Communication and Network Systems. Enough skill of mathematics (especially Fourier transfer) How to use a calculator.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand and explain basis of telecommunication systems.
Be able to understand and explain principles of voice/video coding/decoding schemes.
Be able to understand and explain baseband transmission.
Be able to understand and explain digital modulation/demodulation schemes.
Be able to understand and explain degradation factors on quality of communications.
Be able to understand and explain principles of multiplexing systems in communication systems.

lessons.content: 2.Basic topology of telecommunication systems (1) - Basic configuration - Quality of service
lessons.operation: Test and review. Lecture based on PPT slides. Practice after the class.
lessons.assignments: Understanding protocol of communication and principles of voice and its coding/ decoding

lessons.content: 2.Basic topology of telecommunication systems (2) - protocol of communication 3. Information in telecommunication (1) - principles of voice signal and its coding/ decoding
lessons.operation: Test and review. Lecture based on PPT slides. Practice after the class.
lessons.assignments: Understanding protocol of communication and principles of voice and its coding/ decoding

lessons.content: 3. Information in telecommunication (2) - principles of video signal and its coding/ decoding
lessons.operation: Test and review. Lecture based on PPT slides. Practice after the class.
lessons.assignments: Understanding protocol of communication and principles of video and its coding/ decoding

lessons.content: 4. Basis of information - Entropy: quantity of information 5. Communication disturbance due to imperfections of transmission (1) - Property of noise
lessons.operation: Test and review. Lecture based on PPT slides. Practice after the class
lessons.assignments: Understanding entropy and its calculation. Understanding property of noise and its influence on communication.

lessons.content: 5. Communication disturbance due to imperfections of transmission (2) -Property of linear/non-linear distortion - Property of delay dispersion
lessons.operation: Test and review. Lecture based on PPT slides. Practice after the class.
lessons.assignments: Understanding property of linear/non-linear distortion and delay dispersion. Understanding their influence on communication

lessons.content: Exam 7. Digital modulation (1) - Principle of AD and DA conversion
lessons.operation: Exam Lecture based on PPT slides. Practice after the class.
lessons.assignments: Understanding principle of AD and DA conversion.

lessons.content: Self-evaluation of the exam in previous class 7. Digital modulation (2) - Principle of the transmitter filter
lessons.operation: Test and review. Lecture based on PPT slides. Practice after the class.
lessons.assignments: Understanding principle of the transmitter filter

lessons.content: 7. Digital modulation (2) - Principle of the matched filter
lessons.operation: Test and review. Lecture based on PPT slides. Practice after the class.
lessons.assignments: Understanding principle of the matched filter.

lessons.content: 7. Digital modulation (3) - Modulation method of ASK, PSK and FSK
lessons.operation: Test and review. Lecture based on PPT slides. Practice after the class.
lessons.assignments: Understanding modulation details of ASK, PSK and FSK

lessons.content: 7. Digital modulation (4) - Demodulation method - Bit error rate
lessons.operation: Test and review. Lecture based on PPT slides. Practice after the class.
lessons.assignments: Understanding demodulation method and bit error rate

lessons.content: 8. Multiplexing method - Method of Frequency Division Multiplexing (FDM), Time Division Multiplexing (TDM) and Code Division Multiplexing (CDM).
lessons.operation: Test and review. Lecture based on PPT slides. Practice after the class.
lessons.assignments: Understanding method of FDM, TDM and CDM.

lessons.content: Special lecture by the invited speaker in industry.
Self-evaluation of the exam in previous class
